name: io.github.maxf98/sonos
title: Sonos
description: Hosted Sonos MCP server: playback, volume, grouping and playlists.

notes: Standard MCP OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and dynamic client registration — no pre-registered credentials, nothing env-gated.

The 401 carries no WWW-Authenticate challenge, so discovery falls through to the RFC 9728 well-known path — /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp serves it, and names the MCP origin as its own authorization server.
Scopes (playback-control-all, partner-content:read) come from that protected-resource metadata, so no explicit `scopes` is needed here.
Sonos documents the connector as US-English only.
